sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Digital Magazine Publishing and Sponsored Media Placements

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States-Panama Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA; in force 2012)
Panama-Republic of Korea Double Taxation Agreement (in force)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 23 of 27 April 2015, as amended by Law No. 70 of 2019, establishing Panama's AML/CFT/CPF regime; Executive Decree No. 656 of 30 December 2020 creating and regulating the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales; Law No. 32 of 1927, as amended, for Panamanian S.A. corporate formation and registered agent obligations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of valid national passport of each individual UBO, director, shareholder and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority in the country of citizenship or residence of the beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, or Panamanian consular legalization for issuers in non-Hague jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing or formal incumbency certificate of any corporate shareholder or intermediate parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or equivalent corporate registrar of the jurisdiction in which the shareholder is incorporated
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, or Panamanian consular legalization for non-Hague jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney appointing the Panamanian registered agent and incorporation attorney
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent public authority in the country where the power of attorney is executed
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, or Panamanian consular legalization for non-Hague jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds confirmation issued by the UBO's account-holding financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed financial institution in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or direct banker's confirmation, supplemented by consular legalization where required by the registered agent

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of every UBO, director, shareholder and signatory against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, UK/EU consolidated sanctions lists, and Panama's national AML/CFT lists maintained by the Unidad de Análisis Financiero. PEP screening applies the FATF Recommendation 12 matrix covering domestic, foreign and international-organization PEPs together with family members and close associates, requiring enhanced due diligence, ongoing transaction monitoring, adverse-media review and an independent annual refresh.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Público de Panamá - Servicios En Línea (online corporate name consultation module)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be registered in uppercase and may be expressed in Spanish or another language using the Latin alphabet; names in non-Latin scripts are accepted only after an official transliteration. Every Panamanian S.A. must include the suffix 'S.A.' or the full expression 'Sociedad Anónima' in its registered name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a negative name certificate, the applicant through the registered agent may file a reconsideration petition before the Directorate General of the Registro Público de Panamá within five working days of notification, attaching the negative search certificate and a revised proposed name. If reconsideration is denied, an appeal may be lodged with the Pleno of the Registro Público within five working days from notice. Final administrative remedies may then be pursued before the Third Chamber of the Supreme Court of Justice. Name certificates are not automatically extended; if the 30-day reservation window lapses, a new name search and filing fee are required.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for this digital publishing entity. The statutory registered office may be the address of the licensed Panamanian registered agent, and a virtual office is accepted for a low-risk digital magazine portal with no walk-in clientele, provided all corporate records are accessible at the registered agent's office. If Panamanian-source digital advertising revenue is booked locally, additional physical or management substance in Panama is advisable to support territorial-source tax treatment.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Below 5% annual likelihood for a registered office hosting a standard low-risk digital publishing S.A. with no bearer shares and verified UBO records; the risk rises to approximately 15% where the agent hosts multiple high-risk entities or where nominee/shareholder anomalies are reported to the Unidad de Análisis Financiero.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name availability search and negative-name certificate (buscada de nombre)
UBO/PEP/OFAC/sanctions screening and source-of-funds due diligence
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Panamanian corporate law firm / licensed registered agent

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preparation, legal review and notarization of articles of incorporation (Escritura Pública)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notary tariff plus fixed legal drafting fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registration of the incorporation deed with the Public Registry and issuance of the corporate certificate
Initial beneficial ownership registration with the Registro de Beneficiarios Finales
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos, Ministry of Economy and Finance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory UBO filing fee plus registered-agent filing fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year registered agent, registered office and corporate maintenance
Apostille and consular legalization of foreign identity, incumbency and power-of-attorney documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs / competent notarial authority of the source country
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed apostille and legalization per-document tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Provisional fiscal vendor registration (RUC) and pre-incorporation tax advice
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration fee plus tax advisory fee

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley No. 32 de 1927 (General Corporation Law of the Republic of Panama), as amended by Ley No. 5 de 2010 and Decreto Ley No. 2 de 2010; Articles 1–10 (formation), Article 9 (minimum capital and single-share rule), Articles 17–24 (registered office, resident agent, duties), Articles 30–31 (shares and no-par value), Articles 33–35 (directors and officers).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Personas (Mercantil), Oficina de Inscripción Mercantil y Certificados
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Public Deed of Incorporation) executed before a Notary Public and registered in the Mercantile Book of the Public Registry, accompanied by the Certificado de Búsqueda de Nombre and the Formulario de Inscripción de Sociedad
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; the S.A. may declare any capital sum and must subscribe and issue at least one share with or without par value. No escrow or mandatory bank deposit of capital is required under Ley 32 de 1927; the subscribed share capital must be stated in the deed and is deemed fully paid as declared by the founding shareholder.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 1 OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [•], S.A. Resolved that (1) the subscription and issuance of 100 ordinary shares without par value to the Sole Shareholder be ratified as fully paid in accordance with the declared capital of the Escritura Constitutiva; (2) the registered office is fixed at [•], Panama City, Republic of Panama, and the licensed resident agent is engaged; (3) [•] is appointed President and [•] Secretary, each with full corporate powers; (4) the President is authorized to execute banking resolutions, open corporate liabilities, engage registered attorneys, and present filings to the Registro Público, the Dirección General de Ingresos, and the Municipality; (5) the annual franchise tax and Registry annual fee are declared corporate obligations. So resolved by unanimous vote this [•] day of [•], 202[•].

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Departamento de Consulta de Nombres (physical counter or online SIRE/Registro Público portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to three proposed corporate names in Spanish for a negative name search. Pay the search and reservation fee at the Registry cashier or via the online payment platform. Obtain the certificate of no prior registration, which reserves the name for a statutory grace period during which the deed must be presented for registration.
required_dossiers: Filled name search request form (Formulario de Búsqueda de Nombre)
Copy of the resident agent letter of engagement
Fiscal identification of the applicant (persona natural o jurídica)
Proof of payment of search and reservation fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is already registered or is confusingly similar, select the next alternative from the submitted list; otherwise, file a new name-search request with a written explanation of distinctiveness and await re-issuance of the certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of the Escritura Pública de Constitución
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública in Panama (lawyer-notary) – currently the local chapter of the Colegio Nacional de Abogados
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a Panamanian attorney who will draft the articles of incorporation in Spanish containing company name, purpose (including digital magazine publishing, editorial services, sponsored media placements, and any lawful commercial activity), share structure, capital, registered office address, resident agent clause, and initial directors. Execute the deed before the Notary Public; incorporators need not be physically present if represented under a power of attorney.
required_dossiers: Approved name search certificate from the Registro Público
Valid passports or corporate documents of the incorporators and/or attorneys-in-fact
Resolution of the beneficial owner naming the proposed resident agent and directors
Draft escrow-free capital declaration (for non-manufacturing digital business)
Payment of notary fees (notarial arancel)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or the Registry identifies a drafting defect, request a corrective amendment (nota de enmienda) to the deed before registration, or execute a supplementary public deed rectifying the defective clause.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of State Registry Duties and Publication Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Caja del Registro Público de Panamá or the Registry online payment module (Plataforma de Pagos en Línea)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Compute and pay the inscription tariff (derechos registrales) based on the declared share capital, together with the publication and certification fees. Obtain a stamped official receipt (recibo oficial) evidencing the paid duties, which is a precondition for inscription.
required_dossiers: Registry tariff self-assessment form based on declared capital
Official filing receipt of the Public Registry (order of payment)
Copy of the notarized Escritura Pública
Corporate taxpayer identification if the financing is declared
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tariff is underpaid, pay the difference at the Registry cash desk within 5 working days; if overpaid, file a written request for refund or credit note supported by the original receipts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription in the Public Registry and Issuance of Legal Personality
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá – Sección de Personas (Mercantil), Jurisdicción Nacional
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the notarized Escritura Pública de Constitución together with proof of payment and the name certificate to the Mercantile section. The Registry examines the deed, verifies the legality of the company formation, and issues the certificate of inscription; the corporate existence, limited liability, and legal personality commence as of inscription.
required_dossiers: Original notarized Escritura Pública de Constitución (two copies)
Name search certificate
Official payment receipt of registry duties
Resident agent acceptance letter
Fiscal and legal compliance declaration for the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the inscription is objected or suspended (protesta), obtain the Registry's written observation, execute a corrective public deed or subjoin explanatory documents, and resubmit within 30 days; if the objection is patrimonial, pay the adjusted duties.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Aviso de Operación and Editorial Activity Trade Classification
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Alcaldía/Municipio where the registered office is located (e.g., Municipio de Panamá) – Ventanilla Única de Aviso de Operación or online SIA platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the Aviso de Operación covering the digital magazine publishing and sponsored media placement activity under the municipal economic classification, declaring the office area and number of employees. Pay the proportional annual municipal tax computed on declared capital and obtain the operating card and educational rate certificate (where applicable). The aviso confirms the right to operate a low-risk online editorial business from the registered office.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Registro de la Sociedad (copy of the inscribed deed)
Formulario de Aviso de Operación with ISIC 5813 classification
Lease agreement or ownership title of the registered office premises
Proof of payment of municipal tax
RUC (NIT) provisional or definitive certificate
Copy of the resident agent's acceptance and the board resolution designating the local representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality misclassifies the activity as industrial rather than editorial/professional, present the Escritura Pública purposes clause and ISIC reference to the Ventanilla Única requesting reclassification; appeal the decision within 15 days to the Municipal Board.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of RUC (NIT) and Rubrication of Corporate Books
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas – Ventanilla de Inscripción de Contribuyentes and online TFD
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the S.A. for the Registro Único de Contribuyente (RUC), obtain the NIT (tax identification), and register the corporate ledger books (Libro de Registro de Acciones, Libro de Actas de Asamblea, Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva) with the DGI for authoritative legal recognition. Obtain the RUC certificate and the rubrication confirmation for the statutory books to be used for meetings and shareholder record.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Registro de la Escritura Constitutiva
Aviso de Operación municipal
Identity documents and residence certificate of the legal representative
Lease or property proof for tax domicile
Corporate books (purchased from an authorized printer) for rubrication
Proof of the resident agent and final statutory compliance statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RUC application is delayed or withheld due to lack of municipal consistency, reconcile the domicile address data with the Municipality and DGI, resubmit the issuance fee, and request administrative reconsideration before the DGI Superior Office.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial license body applies; the nearest competent authority for any voluntary commercial formalities is the Ministerio de Comercio e Industrias (MICI) – Dirección Nacional de PyME, while the municipal Alcaldía acts by virtue of the Aviso de Operación.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No statutory operating or manufacturing license is required for digital magazine publishing and sponsored media placements under ISIC 5813; the obtained municipal Aviso de Operación constitutes the only operative administrative permit for online editorial services.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente (MiAMBIENTE) – Dirección de Evaluación y Control Ambiental
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – Category Not Applicable (digital editorial and media placement operates from standard office premises with no industrial or physical production footprint; no EIA registration or full EIA study is mandated).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater, VOC, or hazardous-waste compliance thresholds apply to the server-based magazine publishing activity; any domestic wastewater and solid waste generated at the registered office must comply with municipal sanitation rules and the general water quality standards of Reglamento del Ministerio de Salud (MINSA) for commercial offices.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá – issuance of a fire safety inspection certificate for the office premises; verification of structural load conditions against the building occupation certificate of the Ministerio de Vivienda y Ordenamiento Territorial (MIVIOT); and occupational health clearance from Ministerio de Salud (MINSA) – Dirección de Salud Ocupacional for office-based digital personnel, covering lighting, ergonomics, and e-waste disposal.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas – Panama; online portal: Sede Electrónica at https://sede.mef.gob.pa
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must obtain a RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) by registering with the DGI through a local appointed legal representative or registered agent before commencing Panama-sourced economic activities. The application includes entity incorporation documents, Panamanian apostilled articles, identification of shareholders/directors, and notarized power of attorney. After approval, the DGI issues the RUC and registers the entity for ITBMS.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch elections exist under Panamanian law. A taxpayer may elect the small-taxpayer simplified ITBMS regime if annual gross receipts do not exceed the statutory threshold, and may elect between available withholding agent and simplified remittance procedures; branch and subsidiary formations are structural choices, not tax elections.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios (ITBMS) – value-added tax system
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory upon commencement of taxable operations; no general economic threshold applies. A simplified small-taxpayer regime is available only for annual gross receipts up to USD 36,000.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Designated large taxpayers must issue electronic invoices using DGI-approved software, digitally sign XML documents, transmit them to the DGI in real time, and display a QR code; fiscal clearance is performed through the DGI's Sede Electrónica authorization process.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods from Panama and services rendered to non-residents for use wholly outside Panama are zero-rated for ITBMS. The taxpayer must maintain proof of physical departure of goods or cross-border service provision, commercial invoicing, and evidence of payment received from the non-resident counterparty.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading / Airway Bill or alternative international transport document
Inward Remittance Certificate or payment proof from the foreign buyer
Contract or service agreement for offshore service exports
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The DGI and Customs authorities may retroactively assess unreported ITBMS, claw back zero-rating benefits, apply interest and fines ranging from 100% to 200% of the deficiency, and initiate criminal proceedings where fraudulent export documentation is proven, in accordance with the Código Fiscal and related anti-smuggling and tax evasion statutes.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP) as the apex banking and payment-systems regulator; Banco Nacional de Panamá acts solely as a state-owned commercial bank and fiscal agent. Panama maintains no central bank, no monetary-policy authority, and no sovereign issuance of paper currency, with the US Dollar serving as legal tender and the Balboa minted only as a coin unit.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full, free and unrestricted convertibility under Panama's dollarized monetary system; the Balboa is pegged at a hard 1:1 par to the USD. There are no exchange-control laws, no FX permit requirements, no capital-movement restrictions, and no barriers to profit remittance, dividend distribution, loan repayment or liquidation proceeds. Panama's territorial tax regime subjects only Panama-source income to corporate taxation; foreign-source digital publishing income from Stripe, AdSense and sponsored media placements is outside Panamanian income tax. The only practical friction points are the AML/KYC standards imposed under Law 254 of 2021 on economic substance and the SBP's customer due diligence directives, which require full beneficial-ownership transparency for non-resident-owned Sociedades Anónimas.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None applicable. Panama imposes no mandatory surrender of export proceeds, no forced conversion ratio, no repatriation deadline and no custodial restriction on foreign receipts. Stripe and AdSense payouts in USD or any other currency may be retained overseas or swept at will into the Panamanian operational account, subject solely to the receiving bank's ordinary AML verification of the underlying platform settlement records.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BAC International Bank, Inc. (BAC Credomatic Panama)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-High as a collections and payout aggregation node, but Low-Medium as a primary treasury spine. Offshore digital EMIs such as Wise, Payoneer and Airwallex may lawfully receive Stripe/AdSense settlements as receivable-collection agents, yet they cannot replace a Panamanian SBP-licensed banking relationship for corporate economic-substance evidence, statutory record-keeping and audit-proof cash positioning. Legal constraint: parking platform funds in an unlicensed EMI beyond a 24-hour sweep cycle undermines the Law 254 of 2021 substance file and triggers enhanced source-of-funds scrutiny. Recommended architecture: settle digital-platform revenue into a nominated EMI or US receiving account, then execute a daily USD sweep via SWIFT MT103 or ACH to the Panamanian S.A. operating account; EMIs must never hold equity capital, reserve balances or long-term treasury positions.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Hybrid mandate. Most Tier 1 Panamanian banks permit remote onboarding for non-resident-owned S.A.s provided that (i) the full corporate bundle — escritura constitutiva, certificado de personería jurídica, apostilled board resolutions and shareholder register — is physically presented by the licensed resident agent, and (ii) every director and the ultimate beneficial owner completes a live video interview with the bank's compliance officer. Banco General and Towerbank International accept e-signature closings with notarized/apostilled documents lodged via the resident agent; Banco Nacional de Panamá typically requires physical attendance of at least one officer or the holder of a notarized general power-of-attorney issued to a Panamanian attorney. OECD-resident directors with negative sanctions screening may close within five to ten business days.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident shareholders and directors without demonstrable physical nexus to Panama
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized and apostilled escritura constitutiva and bylaws; current certificado de personería jurídica from the Registro Público de Panamá; valid lease contract (contrato de arrendamiento) for the registered operating premises; payroll records, utility bills and security logs proving staffed Panamanian presence; corporate domicile certificate from the resident agent; sworn UBO declaration and source-of-wealth letter from each shareholder's home bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency, low-value digital advertising inflows from Stripe and AdSense lacking a single master commercial contract
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Twelve months of exported merchant settlement reports from Stripe and AdSense; redacted dashboard evidence of sponsored media placements; a transaction-level reconciliation ledger mapping each platform deposit to the bank account; published magazine samples and editorial sponsorship agreements; internal revenue-recognition policy confirming the ISIC 5813 digital publishing business profile; platform tax certificates and VAT/GST position statements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sudden large capital injection into the escrow account triggering the bank's anomalous-transaction detection
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Pre-funded board minutes approving the share subscription; formal capital call letters; shareholder commitment agreements; remitter's SWIFT instruction bearing the purpose concept 'APORTE DE CAPITAL / EQUITY SUBSCRIPTION'; source-of-funds certificate from the remitting bank; notarized source-of-wealth statement from the shareholder; post-closing annotation of the paid-in capital in the shareholder register and a certified public accountant's 'certificado de capital pagado'.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity caused by nominee officers or complex intermediate holding vehicles
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete chain-of-title documentation from the S.A. up to the controlling natural persons; certified extract of the Beneficial Ownership Registry filed at the Registro Público de Panamá; sworn UBO declaration countersigned by the resident agent; express confirmation that bearer shares are immobilized and registered under Law 10 of 2015; passport, residential proof and professional reference for every ultimate natural-person owner; nominee service agreement if any.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Recurring disbursements to counterparties in jurisdictions classified as higher-risk by OFAC, Lista Clinton or UN/EU sanctions screening
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Counterparty KYB files evidencing incorporation, license status and beneficial ownership; executed commercial contracts with pricing and milestone schedules; negative OFAC/UN/EU sanctions screening reports for every vendor and sponsor; the S.A.'s written AML policy, Enhanced Due Diligence procedures and staff training logs; Law 254 of 2021 economic-substance file demonstrating real employees, premises and expenditure in Panama.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing uses SWIFT MT103 for cross-border equity injections with Field 70 Remittance Information stating 'EQUITY SUBSCRIPTION / APORTE DE CAPITAL — PA_CORP S.A.'; US-origin transfers may use Fedwire or ACH credits to the beneficiary USD account at the Panamanian bank with the same purpose concept. Best practice requires pre-advice: treasury forwards the board resolution, shareholder source-of-funds certificate, and shareholder-register extract to the receiving bank before value date so the credit is posted without a compliance hold. Post-settlement evidence comprises a mirrored treasury ledger, a registered public accountant's certificate of paid-in capital, and statutory annotation in the shareholder registry and minutes book.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail is SWIFT MT103 for routine cross-border disbursements covering software licensing, ad-tech vendors, freelance content production and sponsored-media placements. Structured trade settlements use Commercial Letters of Credit issued under ICC UCP 600, advised through Miami or New York correspondent banks and used for material purchase commitments. Domestic USD clearing is executed through ACH Panamá and the Transactiva real-time system; correspondent lanes via Citibank N.A., J.P. Morgan Chase and Bank of America settle same-day through Fedwire. All outbound messages must carry an accurate commercial purpose (license fees, royalties, production costs, subscription payouts) to avoid correspondent sanctions screening and SWIFT MT103/MT202 chaining errors.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forward contracts in EUR/USD, GBP/USD and JPY/USD executed with the Panamanian licensed bank's global markets desk or its New York/London dealing room, with maturity matched to forecast platform payouts
Cross-currency swaps on EUR/USD and GBP/USD under simplified ISDA 2002 master documentation to neutralize sponsorship and licensing receivables against dollarized operating payables
Vanilla European-style FX options on EUR/USD and GBP/USD purchased for premium only, with sale of options prohibited under treasury governance policy

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on Latin American regional pairs (COP, MXN, BRL) for vendor disbursement hedging in the publishing supply chain, permissible under Panama's free-market FX regime but not applicable to the hard-pegged USD/PAB relationship
Multi-currency treasury sweep accounts maintained at the Panamanian bank to achieve natural hedging by converting only the exact payable amount and avoiding speculative open FX positions

US Treasury money-market placements and USD term deposits as a liquidity buffer, with governance limits confining aggregate derivative notional to a maximum of 100% of 90-day forecast digital-media receivables

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Franchise Tax (Impuesto Anual de Sociedades) - standard authorized capital tier not exceeding USD 10,000
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance, Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before 30 June; full amount is due regardless of business activity; upper-tier capital above USD 10,000 is charged USD 600 according to DGI scale.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic 10% late-payment surcharge plus statutory default interest; three consecutive unpaid years permit the Registro Público to administratively strike off or dissolve the S.A. and prevent issuance of good-standing certificates.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Final Beneficial Owner Sworn Statement (Declaración Jurada Anual de Beneficiario Final) submitted to the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) - Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales (RUB)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary-based filing due within 30 days after the S.A.'s registration anniversary; any share transfer changing ultimate beneficial ownership must additionally be reported within 30 days of the transfer.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to USD 5,000 per Law 23 of 2015 and related decrees, joint liability of legal representative and resident agent, and suspension/denial of the company's solvency or good-standing certificate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración Jurada Anual de ISR) - required only when the S.A. has Panama-source income; an inactive offshore S.A. is not required to file
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance, Panama
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar-year taxpayers must file by 31 March of the following year; taxpayers with a different fiscal year must file within three months of fiscal year-end; quarterly advance ISR payments apply when taxable income exceeds the statutory threshold.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: DGI late-filing fines, monthly default interest on unpaid tax, presumed assessments, and possible criminal tax liability for repeated evasion; does not directly trigger administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit by a Panama-licensed certified public accountant is required when gross annual income exceeds USD 1,000,000 or total assets exceed USD 3,000,000; public-interest, regulated, or DGI-selected entities may be audited irrespective of these thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted in Panama; private S.A. entities may apply IFRS for SMEs or consistent Panamanian accounting principles when no statutory audit is triggered.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The resident agent shall collect and file an annual sworn UBO statement identifying all natural person owners or controllers of at least 10% of shares or voting rights. The S.A. must update the Corporate Share Ledger immediately upon any share transfer; any resulting UBO change must be filed with the RUB within 30 days. The Resident Agent must also obtain updated KYC evidence for each transferor/transferee and maintain the transfer instrument in its compliance file.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members / Share Ledger (Libro de Registro de Acciones)
Register of Directors and Officers (Libro de Directores y Funcionarios)
Minute Book of Shareholder and Board Meetings (Libro de Actas)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350 - 700 per year for resident agent services, registered office, franchise tax payment handling and UBO declaration preparation
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 - 7,500 per year for a Panama-licensed independent audit, depending on transaction volume, IFRS reconciliation and consolidated group scope

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% flat rate on net taxable income of Panamanian source (Código Fiscal, Article 699).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Territorial system: income derived from foreign sources (offshore subscriptions, AdSense/affiliate payouts, sponsored media served to non-Panamanian audiences) falls outside Panamanian ISR, producing a 0% effective rate on such receipts; no general tax holidays apply. The IMAE minimum tax (1% of the higher of net equity or taxable assets) applies only to companies with previous-year gross Panamanian-source income exceeding USD 1.5 million; a 4% presumed/advance dividend tax is paid annually but is creditable against the dividend withholding on actual distributions. Out-of-scope indirect taxes: ITBMS (7%) applies to digital services supplied to Panamanian consumers (Law 57 of 2021).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: DRI - Declaración Jurada de Impuesto sobre la Renta, filed electronically via the DGI 'e-Tax 2.0' web platform (Sede Electrónica de la Dirección General de Ingresos); no paper filing accepted for corporations.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Three months after fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year S.A. the deadline is 31 March of the following year (Arts. 711-713 Código Fiscal). No automatic extension; a six-month extension may be requested with a prepayment of the estimated tax (Art. 711-A).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 - Información general (RUC, razón social, actividad)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax identification number, corporate name, ISIC activity code and registered address.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the Panamanian RUC, local legal representative, and the ISIC 5813 code; foreign directors are identified in Annex B without residential address requirements.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 2 - Ingresos brutos de fuente panameña
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue that is sourced in Panama under the territorial source rules.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exclude foreign subscription and digital-advertising revenue; attach a source-allocation workpaper showing geolocation of users, billing addresses and the place where the underlying services are performed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductions and costs linked to the production of Panamanian-source taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Allocate costs on a causal nexus basis; intercompany charges must satisfy the arm's length standard and be backed by contemporaneous TP documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 8 - Renta neta gravable (NOL carryforwards del Art. 700)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable base after loss carryforwards, exemptions and taxable income adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses may be carried forward for five years only; no carry-back. Foreign-source losses are not allowed to offset Panamanian-source income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 10 - ISR causado y comparación con IMAE
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax computed at 25%; where gross Panamanian income exceeded USD 1.5 million in the prior year, compare against IMAE and pay the greater of the two.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the IMAE comparison in the same form; the 4% advanced dividend tax paid during the year is creditable in this line.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 12 - Saldo a pagar / a favor
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final net tax position after prepayments, the presumed dividend tax credit and withholdings.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay and file before 31 March using the authorised banking channels; any balance in favour may be applied against future taxes or refunded via the DGI refund process.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: fine of USD 50-1,500 (Art. 733); late payment: 10% monthly surcharge capped at 100% of the tax due, plus default interest of 1% per month (12% p.a.); failure to file after DGI notice triggers an ex officio assessment (determinación de oficio), levy on bank accounts, and criminal tax-fraud exposure (Art. 79-F) of 2-5 years' imprisonment for the signatory director.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Anexo de Precios de Transferencia - Informe TP, filed together with the DRI via e-Tax 2.0 (Executive Decree No. 52 of 2013).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Same statutory deadline as the DRI (31 March for calendar-year corporations).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part A - Identificación de contrapartes vinculadas
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: List of related parties, their jurisdiction of residence and the nature of the control relationship.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Identify ultimate beneficial owners and any related recipient of advertising revenue, subscription processing or IP licensing fees.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Quantitative schedule of intercompany payments (royalties, management fees, digital platform fees) and pricing methods used.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Beneficial ownership and commercial rationale must be disclosed; intra-group IP arrangements with zero compensation are high-risk.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part C - Análisis de comparabilidad y ajustes
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Description of the selected OECD method, comparability analysis and any year-end arm's length adjustment.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: In the absence of reliable comparables, present a TNMM with a benchmark study in the language of the contract (Spanish/English).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the TP annex: fine of USD 5,000-10,000; incomplete or unsustainable documentation allows the DGI to re-characterise transactions and make a transfer-pricing adjustment with a 10% monthly surcharge applied to the omitted tax; the taxpayer's burden of proof is reversed, and criminal liability under Art. 79-F may arise where false documentation is filed.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Informe de Sustancia Económica - ISE (Law 254 of 2021; DGI e-Tax 2.0 module).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within six months after the fiscal year-end (by 30 June of the following year for calendar-year entities).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of relevant/mobile activities, including digital publishing, IP licensing, distribution and group financing.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A digital magazine portal earning non-Panamanian-source revenue must declare itself as performing mobile activities (digital services) and cannot claim full exemption without this report.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number of employees, physical premises, annual expenses and where core income-generating activities are managed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the Panamanian headcount, office address, and minutes of board meetings held in Panama; outsourcing to group companies abroad weakens the substance position.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Revenues by ISIC line and by geographical source, applying territorial source rules.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile this report with the source-allocation annex of the DRI; the DGI cross-checks foreign-source exemption claims against ISE data.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-filing, late filing or false information: fines from USD 1,000 to USD 60,000 depending on the entity's gross revenue; repeat non-compliance leads to the DGI's recommendation to the Public Registry for strike-off and a three-year ban on obtaining a new corporation license.
